objective: Owner's go-ahead of 2026-11-23 for the frozen, refereed study of sub-goal B315 with B318, B319 and the first half of B320 (G18 Comparing growth laws, with G5 Dynamics and G17). The exploratory pilot of 23 November found that under two rules added by hand (a new knot receives at most three fresh distinctions; a knot that cannot pay waits) a ring of an odd number of knots returns to its start every two rounds while separate parts come apart from it. Test that result with independent code on real knots: the canonical knot test at every birth, both knot laws, each added rule swapped; what joining through a dead knot and what waiting contribute (the owner's anchors); and whether the ring still returns with no complete round supplied, one birth at a time, in every order and under priorities read from the structure (the owner's time as a pattern and as a priority). First discriminator: an independent third implementation against the pilot's two on the registered rings. Stop at a referee-ready verdict on each frozen prediction.
title: A ring in balance: a ring of knots that returns and gives parts off, its references, and its clock
